create_ReportWorker: create a ReportWorker process to generate training reports and log metrics to TensorBoard
start_collection_ReportWorker: start the ReportWorker collection process to begin gathering episode and timing statistics
state_dict_ReportWorker: get the current state dict from the ReportWorker for checkpointing and resuming training
load_state_dict_ReportWorker: load a previously saved state dict into the ReportWorker to resume training progress
get_window_episode_stats_ReportWorker: retrieve the windowed episode statistics including reward and custom metrics from the ReportWorker
